message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards anywhere in the data acquisition or pipeline code; data is passed directly from loader functions into models without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded via sklearn built-in datasets and local CSV loaders; there is no remote fetch, and no checksum, signature, or authentication mechanism is present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed anywhere in the data preparation or modeling code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code only trains models from scratch using scikit-learn; no pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded, so no integrity verification is performed or needed, but no such control exists.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distribution, class balance, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor defense, trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used in any model's fit method.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial attack/robustness testing framework anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/test/val splits exist and multiple metrics (R², MSE, MAE) are computed, there is no isolation enforcement (e.g., the test set is passed into fit()), no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and no independent verification mechanism to prevent metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, schema checks, shape/range guards, or sanitization are performed before passing data to model.predict or model.fit anywhere in the inference path.
No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions are collected and written to CSV without any NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds on the output values.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical regression models (KNN, LinearRegressor, SVR, DecisionTree, RandomForest), not LLMs, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
